Are you attending Mass Torts Made Perfect (MTMP) in Las Vegas, October 3-5, 2018? Alert hopes to see you there!

There are numerous reasons why trial attorneys and their teams fly to Las Vegas each Spring and Fall for the unique “MTMP experience.” Whether you’re a beginner in the mass tort or class action realm, or a veteran in complex litigation, they’ve created this conference to help you grow your legal practice. At MTMP, lawyers learn about emerging mass torts and class actions and meet the biggest players in these areas of law.

Can Your Intake Handle a Large-Scale Campaign?

Law firms can be crippled by the overwhelming number of inbound phone calls and web leads that flood in during a large mass tort or class action campaign. There are phone calls, contact forms and emails to juggle, plus sending and retrieving retainer contracts and follow-up documents promptly can be challenging for most firms.

Initiating a large-scale campaign is a significant investment, and you want to be confident that your money is well spent.

Even if you handle just part of your inquiries in-house and outsource after-hours, weekends and overflow calls, partnering with a legal answering service could help you capture more leads than ever before – and maximize your return on investment!

Are you planning on attending Mass Torts Made Perfect? Contact us today, and let’s meet at our booth to discuss how we can help improve your law firm intake for your next big campaign so you can make the most of your marketing investment!
